parts.label: Cab and chest
parts.detail: Red cab folds upward into the robot chest; windshield and grille stay attached.

parts.label: Windshield
parts.detail: Blue cab windows become chest windows.

parts.label: Grille
parts.detail: Silver grille stays on the folding cab front.

parts.label: Head
parts.detail: Robot head positioned above the chest.

parts.label: Crest
parts.detail: Red helmet crest attached above the head.

parts.label: Hip assembly
parts.detail: Pelvis connects the torso to the two legs.

parts.label: Left leg
parts.detail: Rear chassis section becomes the left leg.

parts.label: Right leg
parts.detail: Rear chassis section becomes the right leg.

parts.label: Left foot
parts.detail: Red foot attached below the left leg.

parts.label: Right foot
parts.detail: Red foot attached below the right leg.

parts.label: Left arm
parts.detail: Left blue truck side assembly moves into arm position.

parts.label: Right arm
parts.detail: Right blue truck side assembly moves into arm position.

parts.label: Left hand
parts.detail: Metal hand attached below left arm.

parts.label: Right hand
parts.detail: Metal hand attached below right arm.

parts.label: Left front wheel
parts.detail: Front tire moves with left side assembly toward the shoulder.

parts.label: Right front wheel
parts.detail: Front tire moves with right side assembly toward the shoulder.

parts.label: Left rear wheel
parts.detail: Rear tire attached to the outside of the left leg.

parts.label: Right rear wheel
parts.detail: Rear tire attached to the outside of the right leg.

parts.label: Bumper
parts.detail: Bumper folds with the cab and ends near the waist.

parts.label: Left exhaust stack
parts.detail: Stack remains attached behind the left shoulder assembly.

parts.label: Right exhaust stack
parts.detail: Stack remains attached behind the right shoulder assembly.

labels.text: Front tires travel with side assemblies

steps.label: Truck form
steps.caption: Cab, side structures, wheels, and rear chassis begin in truck arrangement.

steps.label: Folding
steps.caption: Cab rotates upward as side structures swing toward the arm positions.

steps.label: Robot form
steps.caption: The cab forms the chest; rear chassis and side assemblies form legs and arms.
